about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Product Engineer — Full-Stack
about.description:
I'm a Product Engineer who builds multi-tenant SaaS end to end — design, frontend, and backend. Four years in frontend engineering, the last two spent shipping complete products rather than screens.

My work centres on multi-tenant architecture: one codebase and one deployment serving many fully isolated tenants, with the data boundary enforced in Postgres through Row-Level Security rather than in routing or application code. Alongside that, reusable component libraries and design-token systems that cut delivery time for new features.

Everything I ship is Arabic-first. Full Arabic (RTL) / English internationalization built with logical CSS properties — not a mirrored afterthought.

I take ideas from concept to production using a modern AI-assisted workflow, delivering the output of a small team as a single engineer. I'm comfortable owning products independently in fast-paced, remote teams.
